metric_notes.nloc: Lizard file-level NLOC; a file must meet the configured minimum before other metrics are evaluated.
metric_notes.concrete_method_count: Lizard-recognized concrete functions/methods; constructors excluded for Java.
metric_notes.callable_entry_count: Non-empty, non-abstract test entries: Python public-by-naming-convention functions/methods; JavaScript exported functions and public methods of exported classes; Java non-private concrete methods.
metric_notes.total_cyclomatic_complexity: Sum of Lizard function/method cyclomatic complexity.
metric_notes.cross_file_internal_method_fanout: Unique resolved production functions/methods in other project files plus unresolved call sites with cross-file project candidates.
metric_notes.resolved_cross_file_internal_method_fano: Unique statically resolved production functions/methods in other project files.
metric_notes.unresolved_cross_file_candidate_call_sit: Call sites that have cross-file project candidates but cannot be resolved to one definition; each site counts once.
